caption: The worked example follows |01⟩ through CNOT(1→2), CNOT(2→1), CNOT(1→2): (q1,q2) goes (0,1) → (0,1) → (1,1) → (1,0). The middle gate reverses the control, and the final |10⟩ is |01⟩ with its two bits swapped.

spec.title: SWAP worked example
spec.aria: A five-step left-to-right chain follows the basis state |01⟩ through CNOT(1→2), CNOT(2→1) and CNOT(1→2), ending at |10⟩.
